newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India buy tender attracts seven offers of Dubai.
newsitem.headline: India buy tender attracts seven offers of Dubai.

text.p: Seven cargoes of Dubai crude oil have been offered into state-owned Indian Oil Corp's (IOC) July buying tender, traders said on Thursday.
The most aggressive offers were from a western trader, who offered two Dubai cargoes at first-half month quotes +31 cents per barrel and +32.
The same trader offered a third cargo at first-half month quotes +38.
The other Dubai crude offers ranged from first-half month quotes +36 to first-half month quotes +50.
Six very large crude carriers (VLCC) of Nigerian Qua Iboe crude were also offered, by two U.S. majors, two western traders and a European major.
Only one 900,000-barrel cargo of Egytian Gulf of Suez crude was offered by a western trader, market sources said.
The tender closed on Wednesday and an award was expected later on Thursday.
Traders said they expected IOC to take two cargoes of Dubai and three cargoes of Qua Iboe.
In its June buying tender, IOC awarded three cargoes of Dubai crude, two VLCCs of Qua Iboe and one VLCC of Suez Blend.
